name: Talk to Doc by sadik.ai
author: sadikai01

sections.description:
Connect your WordPress site seamlessly to a chatbot for each of your PDF documents via sadik.ai with this easy-to-use plugin.

Bringing the best of PDF Analyzing to WordPress

  • Analyze all PDF links
  • Direct chat in your website no need to leave.

External services

This plugin embeds an iframe which is used to pass the document URL to sadik.ai. It sends the file each time a user clicks on the “Talk to Doc” icon. This information is then used in the subsequent iframe that is displayed to the user who can then query the document through the chatbot within the iframe.

This service is provided by “Appanzee Inc.”: terms of use, privacy policy.
sections.installation:
Installation from within WordPress

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Talk to Doc by sadik.ai.
  3. Install and activate the Talk to Doc by sadik.ai plugin.

Manual installation

  1. Upload the entire sadik-ai-talk-to-doc folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Visit Plugins.
  3. Activate the Sadik talk to doc plugin.

After activation

  1. Visit the new sadik talk to doc menu.
  2. Subscribe to embed plan.
  3. After subscription, you will soon start noticing the sadik red logo icon beside any PDF link.
sections.faq:
For more information, visit the official Talk to Doc by sadik.ai webpage.

What are the minimum requirements for Talk to Doc by sadik.ai?

In order to successfully install and use Talk to Doc by sadik.ai, your site must meet the following requirements:

  • WordPress version 5.2+
  • PHP version 5.6+
  • Modern browser
  • Is publicly accessible – it isn’t in maintenance mode, accessible only via password, or otherwise blocked
  • An active subscription to the sadik.ai service.

Where can I get additional support?

Please create a new topic on our WordPress.org support forum. Be sure to follow the support forum guidelines when posting.
